Triage: labeled `finding` + `domain:ui` (routing only — awaiting first-touch grading). Observation class: the ADR-0049 `z.never()` tombstones' `.describe()` remediation text never reaches the author at runtime (zod emits its generic "expected never"). Real DX gap, no user-blocking defect today. Grading note for first touch: the fix likely lives in a shared error-map / refusal-presentation layer, and whether it belongs here or in the spec's error-guidance face (objectstack `packages/spec`) should be settled by reading which package owns the parse call — if it lands spec-side, this transfers per file-at-destination.

Concentrated triage batch: `finding` → `pm:queue` + `domain:ui`, Task, M — the ADR-0049 tombstone convention's remediation text (`.describe('RETIRED (objectui#NNNN) — use X instead')`) never reaches the author: the runtime message is zod's generic "expected never". The ruled outcome is LOUD refusal; a refusal that names the key but not the remedy is half of it. Fix: carry the describe text into the issue message (error map scoped to the tombstone members, or a refine-based tombstone helper) — one shared mechanism, all nine members, pinned on the message content; accept set unchanged.
